Name: qryProviderServiceCosts_ByFiscalYear
Sql:
SELECT psc.FiscalYear, p.ProviderID, p.ProviderName, Sum(csp.AnnualEstCost) AS TotalCost, Sum([csp.AnnualEstCost]/[qryCosts_ByFiscalYear].[TotalCost]) AS PctCost
FROM tblProviders AS p INNER JOIN ((tblProviderServiceCatalog AS psc INNER JOIN qryCosts_ByFiscalYear ON psc.FiscalYear = qryCosts_ByFiscalYear.FiscalYear) INNER JOIN tblClientServicePlan AS csp ON psc.ProviderServiceCatalogID = csp.ProviderServiceCatalogID) ON p.ProviderID = psc.ProviderID
WHERE (((csp.Status)<>"Cancelled"))
GROUP BY psc.FiscalYear, p.ProviderID, p.ProviderName;
